key_insight: A hybrid LLM-guided search loop is a strong controller for quantum reservoir architecture design, giving the most consistent performance across benchmark tasks without claiming universal optimality.
engineering_relevance: For quantum machine learning practitioners, the work shows that architecture search for QRC can be automated with validated hybrid optimization to improve results under tight evaluation budgets.
method: Formulate QRC design as constrained black-box architecture search.
Compare random, evolutionary, Bayesian/TPE, feedback-LLM, and hybrid LLM+memory/mutation/crossover search.
Evaluate candidate architectures in a simulator with identical budgets across tasks.
evidence_signal: Using a 25-evaluation budget and three seeds on NARMA10, Mackey-Glass, and temporal parity, the hybrid method ranked first on two tasks and reduced Mackey-Glass error by 23.6% versus random search.
watch_item: The gains depend on a simulator-based benchmark and careful search-loop design, so the approach should be validated on additional tasks and hardware settings before generalizing.
paper_title: Hybrid LLM-Guided Search for Quantum Reservoir Architecture Design
